name: Black Sperm

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK (+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: This DMG is not shared with targets that cannot take damage. Before actively casting the Ultimate, absorbs every Split Black Sperm on the field; each one raises Ultimate DMG by an extra 20%, lasting until the next actively cast skill. Deals a 5-hit combo to an entire enemy row for 2400% ATK (+2) shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Free], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Raises own [All DMG Amplification] by 20% and lowers the [All DMG Reduction] of the target's row by 20% for 2 rounds (undispellable). This DMG is not shared with targets that cannot take damage. Before actively casting the Ultimate, absorbs every Split Black Sperm on the field; each one raises Ultimate DMG by an extra 30%, lasting until the next actively cast skill. Deals a 5-hit combo to an entire enemy row for 3000% ATK (+2) shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Free], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently raises own HP by (+20). On entry, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 20% [Support Enhancement]. In the first 9 rounds, when about to be defeated, enters [Undefeated] and absorbs all damage taken during it; on the user's next action, recovers 100% HP and keeps fighting, up to 4 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently raises own HP by (+20). On entry, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 30% [Support Enhancement]. In the first 9 rounds, when about to be defeated, enters [Undefeated] and absorbs all damage taken during it; on the user's next action, recovers 100% HP and keeps fighting, up to 5 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently raises own HP by (+20). On entry, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 40% [Support Enhancement]. In the first 9 rounds, when about to be defeated, enters [Undefeated] and absorbs all damage taken during it; on the user's next action, recovers 100% HP and keeps fighting, up to 6 times.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy acts, every Split Black Sperm on the field has a 70% chance to pursue all enemies, each dealing 480% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG]. On entry, permanently reduces DMG taken by 30%. After each hit taken, splits off 2 Black Sperm to fight alongside; splits inherit 100% of the host's base ATK, up to 8 at once (cannot be summoned while minion slots conflict).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy acts, every Split Black Sperm on the field has a 100% chance to pursue all enemies, each dealing 620% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG]. When a same-row ally triggers [Regroup], Black Sperm immediately splits to its maximum count and launches a [Charged Pursuit] at 120% skill power. On entry, permanently reduces DMG taken by 50%. After each hit taken, splits off 4 Black Sperm to fight alongside; splits inherit 120% of the host's base ATK, up to 8 at once (cannot be summoned while minion slots conflict).

effects.desc: Absorbs all damage received during this period, restoring HP on the next turn.
Attacks out of turn with a predetermined skill strength percentage.

bio: UR+ Form of Black Sperm. An incredibly dangerous Dragon-level monster with infinite cell splitting capabilities, overwhelming enemies with sheer numbers.
